findings.problem: Subject uses banned words 'Guaranteed' and 'act now' and promises approval (claims rule 1). Length is fine (43 characters).
findings.fix: Use a calm subject such as 'Find a card that fits you'.

findings.problem: Preview says CreditX will 'fix your credit' (claims rule 4) and 'get you approved today' (claims rule 1).
findings.fix: Rewrite as 'Compare card options that match where your credit is today.'

findings.problem: Body reads a score back: 'Your 480 score is no problem'. This breaks claims rule 5 and implies a lookup and a promise that the score won't matter.
findings.fix: Remove the score. Speak to the group, e.g. 'If you're building credit, these options may fit.'

findings.problem: 'This is your last chance. Don't miss out.' is banned urgency and pressure language.
findings.fix: Delete the line or replace it with a calm, no-pressure sentence.

findings.problem: There are two links where the rules allow exactly one main link. The second, https://creditx.example/hurry, is not the allowed URL.
findings.fix: Remove line 12 and keep only the https://creditx.example/advisor link.

findings.problem: Button text 'Apply now' implies CreditX takes applications and adds pressure.

The required exact line 'CreditX Advisor suggests cards. The card issuer makes the approval decision.' is missing. Line 6 only says 'suggests cards that may fit you' and never says who decides (claims rule 6).
findings.fix: Add the exact required line to the body.

findings.problem: There is no sign-off ('Here to help you choose well, / The CreditX Advisor team').
findings.fix: Add the sign-off at the end of the email.

findings.problem: The two-line plain-text footer with {{company_address}} and {{unsubscribe_url}} is missing.
findings.fix: Add the two footer lines from emails.md after the sign-off.
